7 Functional specification
The following section only describes additional TTCAN specific ’Functional specifica-
tions’. The Specification of CAN Driver [4] is the base of this TtcanDrv ’extension’.
For a description of the specific functional behaviour of TTCAN refer to the Specifica-
tion of the TTCAN Interface [7] and the TTCAN ISO Specification [1].
